fact: SSGI's Director General says the digital addressing system is currently being implemented at various stages across several cities.
SSGI signed an agreement on 13 December 2025 with Arba Minch, Jinka and Wolayita Sodo to start preparing and implementing a digital addressing system (eDAS).
SSGI's Deputy Director General says eDAS is already being practically implemented in 73 cities across Ethiopia.
SSGI's Deputy Director General says eDAS integrates digital identification (Fayda), postal and parcel delivery services and other digital platforms.
Ethiopia's Minister of Innovation and Technology said the digital addressing system, already initiated in selected cities, should be expanded nationwide through coordinated stakeholder engagement.
